references.text: The spies reported on the land flowing with milk and honey, confirming that the land was indeed good.
God's promise of a good and vast land flowing with milk and honey, which Joshua and Caleb confirm here.
The spies brought fruit from the land and confirmed that it was a good land that the Lord gives them.
Description of the good land with streams, springs, wheat, barley, grapevines, and other blessings.
Continuation of Joshua's and Caleb's speech, where they describe the land flowing with milk and honey.
Caleb reminds them that he brought back a faithful report about the good land.
The book of Hebrews refers to Israel's disobedience in the wilderness and their lack of faith in the good land.
